// Animation state stays outside saved character data; gait follows actual distance.
const heroMotion=new WeakMap();
function heroAnimation(entity){
 let m=heroMotion.get(entity);
 if(!m){m={x:entity.x,y:entity.y,phase:0,stride:0};heroMotion.set(entity,m)}
 const distance=Math.hypot(entity.x-m.x,entity.y-m.y);

 if(distance>0.01&&distance<30){m.phase+=distance*.15;m.stride=Math.min(1,m.stride+.25)}
 else m.stride*=.72;
 return m;
}
function drawClassHero(entity,scale){
 const appearance=classAppearance(entity),atlas=appearance.atlas;if(!atlas.complete||!atlas.naturalWidth)return false;

 const magic=entity.class==='mage'||entity.class==='cleric';
 const dodge=entity.dodgeTime>0?Math.sin(Math.PI*(1-entity.dodgeTime/.4)):0;
 const recoil=entity.hitTime>0?Math.sin(Math.PI*(1-Math.min(1,entity.hitTime/.2))):0;
 const breathe=Math.sin(animationClock*2.5+(entity.x%7))*.35;

 ctx.rotate(gait*.025+strike*(magic?-.04:.13)+dodge*.28-recoil*.07);

 if(entity.hitTime>0)ctx.globalAlpha=.65+.35*Math.abs(Math.sin(animationClock*35));

 for(let i=0;i<bands;i++){
  const top=i/bands,bottom=(i+1)/bands,srcY=sy+sh*top,srcH=sh*(bottom-top);
  const y=-height+height*top,h=height/bands;
  const lower=Math.max(0,(top-.72)/.28),sway=gait*Math.sin(top*Math.PI)*.7*scale;
  if(lower>0){
   for(let leg=0;leg<2;leg++){
    const step=gait*(leg===0?1:-1),offset=step*lower*2.5*scale;
    ctx.drawImage(atlas,sx+leg*sw/2,srcY,sw/2,srcH,-width/2+leg*width/2+offset,y-Math.max(0,step)*lower*1.8*scale,width/2,h+.35);
   }
  }else{
   const gesture=(strike*(magic?-1:2)+cast*-2)*Math.sin(top*Math.PI)*scale;
   ctx.drawImage(atlas,sx,srcY,sw,srcH,-width/2+sway+gesture,y,width,h+.35);
  }
 }
 ctx.restore();return true;
}

function drawBattleHero(entity,scale){if(drawClassHero(entity,scale))return true;if(entity.class!=='warrior')return false;const direction=battleDirection(entity.faceX||0,entity.faceY||1);let state=entity.hitTime>0?'hit':entity.attack>0?'attack':entity.walking||entity.moving?'walk':'idle';let key='warrior_'+state+'_'+(state==='hit'?'down':direction);if(!battleArt[key])key='warrior_idle_'+(direction==='up'?'up':'down');return drawBattleAsset(key,entity.x,entity.y,scale,state==='attack'?1-entity.attack/.32:state==='hit'?1-entity.hitTime/.2:null)}
function drawBattleMonster(e){const kind=e.kind==='bat'?'bat':e.kind==='slime'?'slime':null;if(!kind)return false;const dir=battleDirection(player.x-e.x,player.y-e.y);const state=e.hitTime>0?'hit':e.windup>0?'attack':Math.hypot(player.x-e.x,player.y-e.y)<230?'walk':'idle';let key=kind+'_'+state+'_'+(state==='hit'?'down':dir);if(!battleArt[key])key=kind+'_idle_down';return drawBattleAsset(key,e.x,e.y,2,state==='attack'?1-e.windup/(e.windupLength||.8):state==='hit'?1-e.hitTime/.2:null)}

function gearSetBonus(owner){let attack=0,guard=0;for(const g of gearSetGroups(owner)){if(g.count>=3)attack+=g.tier;if(g.count>=5)guard+=g.tier;if(g.count>=7){attack+=g.tier*2;guard+=g.tier*2;}}return {attack,guard}}

let tavernRollReadyAt=0;
function tavernStats(){return townQuestState._tavern||(townQuestState._tavern={played:0,wins:0,losses:0,pushes:0,net:0})}
function tavernDie(value){const dots={1:[4],2:[0,8],3:[0,4,8],4:[0,2,6,8],5:[0,2,4,6,8],6:[0,2,3,5,6,8]}[value];return '<span class="tavernDie" role="img" aria-label="Die showing '+value+'">'+Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>'<i class="'+(dots.includes(i)?'lit':'')+'"></i>').join('')+'</span>'}
function tavernPanel(text,choices,art=''){if(!hasStarted||!activeMap.town||!tavernNames[mapId])return;openAdventureDialog(tavernNames[mapId],text,choices);const panel=document.getElementById('adventureScreen');panel.classList.add('tavernView');panel.querySelector('.screenClose').setAttribute('aria-label','Close tavern');document.getElementById('adventureText').innerHTML='<div class="tavernWelcome"><span class="tavernEyebrow">THE INNKEEPER’S TABLE</span><div class="tavernWallet">◈ '+player.coins+' <small>crowns in your purse</small></div></div>'+art+'<div class="tavernCopy">'+text.replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</div>';panel.querySelector('.screenFoot').textContent='Wagers use the crowns in your purse. Every result saves immediately.';}
const tavernSymbols=[{name:'Crown',glyph:'♛'},{name:'Ruby',glyph:'◆'},{name:'Clover',glyph:'♧'},{name:'Leaf',glyph:'❧'},{name:'Moon',glyph:'☾'}];
const tavernGameNames={coin:'Coin Toss',dice:'Dice Duel',slots:'Ember Reels',highcard:'High Card',blackjack:'Blackjack'};
function tavernHandActive(){return tavernStats().hand?.status==='active'}
function openTavern(){if(tavernHandActive()){showBlackjack();return}const st=tavernStats();tavernPanel('Warm lanterns, worn oak, and a seat by the fire.\nChoose a game. Wager 1, 5, 10, or 25 crowns.',[{label:'Ember Reels · Slot machine',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('slots')},{label:'Blackjack · Hit or stand',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('blackjack')},{label:'High Card · Draw against the dealer',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('highcard')},{label:'Coin Toss · Heads or tails',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('coin')},{label:'Dice Duel · Highest roll wins',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('dice')},{label:'Leave the tavern',action:()=>{}}],'<div class="tavernTable"><span class="tavernCoin" aria-hidden="true">♛</span>'+tavernCard({rank:1,suit:'♠'})+tavernCard({rank:13,suit:'♥'})+'</div><div class="tavernRecord">'+st.played+' rounds · '+st.wins+' win'+(st.wins===1?'':'s')+' · Net '+(st.net>=0?'+':'')+st.net+' crowns</div>');}
function chooseTavernWager(game){if(!tavernGameNames[game])return;if(tavernHandActive()){showBlackjack();return}const rules={coin:'Call heads or tails. Wins pay your stake in profit.',dice:'Beat the innkeeper’s die. Wins pay your stake in profit; ties refund it.',slots:'Three crowns return 20× your wager. Three matching other symbols return 10×. Any pair returns your wager. No match loses it. Returns include your original stake; all five symbols have equal odds.',highcard:'Draw from one shuffled deck. Aces are high; suits do not break ties. A higher card wins your stake in profit; equal ranks refund it.',blackjack:'Reach 21 without going over. Aces count as 1 or 11. The dealer stands on all 17s. All wins, including blackjack, pay 1:1 profit; ties refund your stake. No splitting, doubling, or insurance.'};tavernPanel(tavernGameNames[game].toUpperCase()+'\n'+rules[game]+'\nChoose your wager.'+(player.coins<1?'\nYour purse is empty. Earn some crowns on your adventures first.':''),[...[1,5,10,25].map(stake=>({label:'Wager '+stake+' crown'+(stake===1?'':'s'),disabled:player.coins<stake,action:()=>game==='coin'?tavernPanel('Wager: '+stake+' crowns.\nCall the coin before the innkeeper flips it.',[{label:'Heads · Wager '+stake,action:()=>playTavernRound('coin',stake,'heads')},{label:'Tails · Wager '+stake,action:()=>playTavernRound('coin',stake,'tails')},{label:'Change wager',action:()=>chooseTavernWager('coin')}],'<div class="tavernTable"><span class="tavernCoin" aria-hidden="true">✦</span></div>'):game==='blackjack'?startBlackjack(stake):playTavernRound(game,stake)})),{label:'Back to the tavern',action:openTavern}]);}
function playTavernRound(game,stake,call){if(tavernHandActive()){showBlackjack();return false}if(game==='slots'||game==='highcard')return playTavernExtra(game,stake);return playTavernClassic(game,stake,call)}
function playTavernClassic(game,stake,call){if(!hasStarted||!activeMap.town||!tavernNames[mapId]||!['coin','dice'].includes(game)||![1,5,10,25].includes(stake)||(game==='coin'&&!['heads','tails'].includes(call)))return false;if(Date.now()<tavernRollReadyAt){chooseTavernWager(game);return false}if(player.coins<stake){chooseTavernWager(game);return false}const before=player.coins,a=game==='coin'?(Math.random()<.5?'heads':'tails'):1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6),b=game==='dice'?1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6):call,result=a===b?(game==='dice'?'push':'win'):game==='dice'&&a>b?'win':'loss',net=result==='win'?stake:result==='loss'?-stake:0;player.coins+=net;tavernRollReadyAt=Date.now()+600;const st=tavernStats();st.played++;st[result==='win'?'wins':result==='loss'?'losses':'pushes']++;st.net+=net;st.lastRound={game,stake,call:call||null,a,b,result,net,before,after:player.coins,town:mapId,time:Date.now()};saveGame();ui();const title=result==='win'?'You win! +'+stake+' crowns':result==='push'?'A tie. Your wager is returned.':'The innkeeper wins. −'+stake+' crowns';const detail=game==='coin'?'The coin lands '+a.toUpperCase()+'. You called '+call.toUpperCase()+'.':'Your die: '+a+' · Innkeeper’s die: '+b+'.';const art=game==='dice'?'<div class="tavernTable tavernRolled"><div>You'+tavernDie(a)+'</div><span class="tavernVersus">vs</span><div>Innkeeper'+tavernDie(b)+'</div></div>':'<div class="tavernTable tavernRolled"><span class="tavernCoin">'+(a==='heads'?'✦':'◈')+'</span></div>';tavernPanel(title+'\n'+detail+'\nWager: '+stake+' · Purse: '+before+' → '+player.coins+' crowns.',[{label:'Play again · Choose wager',action:()=>chooseTavernWager(game)},{label:'Choose another game',action:openTavern},{label:'Leave the tavern',action:()=>{}}],art);return true;}
function tavernCanWager(stake){return hasStarted&&activeMap.town&&!!tavernNames[mapId]&&[1,5,10,25].includes(stake)&&player.coins>=stake&&Date.now()>=tavernRollReadyAt&&!tavernHandActive()}
function recordTavernRound(game,stake,before,result,extra={}){const st=tavernStats(),net=player.coins-before;st.played++;st[result==='win'?'wins':result==='loss'?'losses':'pushes']++;st.net+=net;st.lastRound={game,stake,before,after:player.coins,result,net,town:mapId,time:Date.now(),...extra};tavernRollReadyAt=Date.now()+600;saveGame();ui();}
function tavernResult(game,stake,before,result,detail,art){const net=player.coins-before,title=result==='win'?'You win! +'+net+' crown'+(net===1?'':'s'):result==='push'?'Your wager is returned.':'You lose your wager. −'+stake+' crown'+(stake===1?'':'s');tavernPanel(title+'\n'+detail+'\nWager: '+stake+' · Purse: '+before+' → '+player.coins+' crowns.',[{label:'Play again · Choose wager',action:()=>chooseTavernWager(game)},{label:'Choose another game',action:openTavern},{label:'Leave the tavern',action:()=>{}}],art);}
function tavernDeck(){const deck=[];for(const suit of ['♠','♥','♦','♣'])for(let rank=1;rank<=13;rank++)deck.push({rank,suit});for(let i=deck.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[deck[i],deck[j]]=[deck[j],deck[i]]}return deck}
function tavernCard(card,hidden=false){if(hidden)return '<span class="tavernCard cardBack" role="img" aria-label="Face-down card">✦</span>';const rank=({1:'A',11:'J',12:'Q',13:'K'})[card.rank]||card.rank;return '<span class="tavernCard '+(['♥','♦'].includes(card.suit)?'cardRed':'')+'" role="img" aria-label="'+rank+' '+card.suit+'"><small>'+rank+'</small><b>'+card.suit+'</b></span>'}
function playTavernExtra(game,stake){if(!['slots','highcard'].includes(game)||!tavernCanWager(stake))return false;const before=player.coins;let result,detail,art,extra;if(game==='slots'){const reels=Array.from({length:3},()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*5)),same=new Set(reels).size,mult=same===1?(reels[0]===0?20:10):same===2?1:0;player.coins+=stake*(mult-1);result=mult>1?'win':mult===1?'push':'loss';detail=reels.map(i=>tavernSymbols[i].name).join(' · ')+'\nTotal return: '+stake*mult+' crowns (includes your stake).';art='<div class="tavernSlots tavernRolled">'+reels.map(i=>'<div class="tavernReel" role="img" aria-label="'+tavernSymbols[i].name+'"><b>'+tavernSymbols[i].glyph+'</b><small>'+tavernSymbols[i].name+'</small></div>').join('')+'</div>';extra={reels,mult};}else{const deck=tavernDeck(),a=deck.pop(),b=deck.pop(),value=c=>c.rank===1?14:c.rank;result=value(a)>value(b)?'win':value(a)===value(b)?'push':'loss';player.coins+=result==='win'?stake:result==='loss'?-stake:0;detail='Aces are high. '+(result==='push'?'Equal ranks tie.':'Higher rank wins.');art='<div class="tavernTable"><div>You'+tavernCard(a)+'</div><span>vs</span><div>Innkeeper'+tavernCard(b)+'</div></div>';extra={a,b};}recordTavernRound(game,stake,before,result,extra);tavernResult(game,stake,before,result,detail,art);return true;}
function blackjackValue(cards){let total=0,aces=0;for(const c of cards){total+=c.rank===1?11:Math.min(c.rank,10);if(c.rank===1)aces++}while(total>21&&aces-- >0)total-=10;return total}
function startBlackjack(stake){if(!tavernCanWager(stake))return false;const deck=tavernDeck(),hand={status:'active',town:mapId,stake,before:player.coins,deck,playerCards:[deck.pop(),deck.pop()],dealerCards:[deck.pop(),deck.pop()]};tavernStats().hand=hand;player.coins-=stake;saveGame();ui();if(blackjackValue(hand.playerCards)===21||blackjackValue(hand.dealerCards)===21)settleBlackjack(true);else showBlackjack();return true;}
function blackjackAction(action){const hand=tavernStats().hand;if(!hasStarted||!activeMap.town||!tavernNames[mapId]||!hand||hand.status!=='active'||!['hit','stand'].includes(action))return false;if(action==='hit'){hand.playerCards.push(hand.deck.pop());saveGame();if(blackjackValue(hand.playerCards)>=21)settleBlackjack();else showBlackjack();}else settleBlackjack();return true;}
function settleBlackjack(natural=false){const h=tavernStats().hand;if(!h||h.status!=='active')return false;const p=blackjackValue(h.playerCards);if(!natural&&p<=21)while(blackjackValue(h.dealerCards)<17)h.dealerCards.push(h.deck.pop());const d=blackjackValue(h.dealerCards),pn=h.playerCards.length===2&&p===21,dn=h.dealerCards.length===2&&d===21,result=p>21?'loss':pn||dn?(pn&&dn?'push':pn?'win':'loss'):d>21||p>d?'win':p===d?'push':'loss';h.status='settled';h.result=result;player.coins+=result==='win'?h.stake*2:result==='push'?h.stake:0;recordTavernRound('blackjack',h.stake,h.before,result,{playerCards:h.playerCards,dealerCards:h.dealerCards});showBlackjack();return true;}
function showBlackjack(){const h=tavernStats().hand;if(!h)return;const active=h.status==='active',p=blackjackValue(h.playerCards),d=blackjackValue(h.dealerCards),art='<div class="blackjackTable"><div class="blackjackRow"><span>Innkeeper · '+(active?'?':d)+'</span><div>'+h.dealerCards.map((c,i)=>tavernCard(c,active&&i>0)).join('')+'</div></div><div class="blackjackRow"><span>You · '+p+'</span><div>'+h.playerCards.map(c=>tavernCard(c)).join('')+'</div></div></div>';if(!active){tavernResult('blackjack',h.stake,h.before,h.result,(p>21?'You bust.':d>21?'The innkeeper busts.':p===21&&h.playerCards.length===2?'Blackjack!':'Hand complete.')+' Your total: '+p+' · Innkeeper: '+d+'.',art);return}tavernPanel('BLACKJACK · Wager: '+h.stake+' crown'+(h.stake===1?'':'s')+' (already placed).\nHit to draw a card. Stand to let the innkeeper play.\nYour hand saves after every draw. You can leave and resume later.',[{label:'Hit · Draw a card',action:()=>blackjackAction('hit')},{label:'Stand · Finish hand',action:()=>blackjackAction('stand')},{label:'Leave table · Resume later',action:()=>{saveGame()}}],art);}

const slayerRanks=[{name:'Novice',marks:0,bonus:0},{name:'Tracker',marks:5,bonus:40},{name:'Hunter',marks:15,bonus:80},{name:'Warden',marks:35,bonus:160},{name:'Master Slayer',marks:70,bonus:300}];
function slayerState(){return townQuestState._slayers||(townQuestState._slayers={joined:false,marks:0,completed:0,hunts:{},rankRewards:[]})}
function slayerHunt(id){return slayerState().hunts[id]||null}
function slayerRank(){return slayerRanks.filter(r=>slayerState().marks>=r.marks).at(-1)}
function slayerTerms(id){const d=slayerContracts[id],tier=Math.min(5,slayerHunt(id)?.completed||0);return {target:d.target+tier*2,coins:Math.round(d.coins*(1+tier*.1)),xp:Math.round(d.xp*(1+tier*.1)),marks:d.marks,tier}}
function slayerActive(){return Object.entries(slayerState().hunts).filter(([id,h])=>slayerContracts[id]&&h.accepted)}
function atSlayersHall(){return hasStarted&&activeMap.town&&!!tavernNames[mapId]}
function slayerRewardText(t){return t.coins+' crowns · '+t.xp+' XP · '+t.marks+' Slayer Mark'+(t.marks===1?'':'s')}
function slayerPanel(text,choices,art=''){if(!atSlayersHall())return;openAdventureDialog('Monster Slayers Hall',text,choices);const panel=document.getElementById('adventureScreen');panel.classList.add('slayerView');panel.querySelector('.screenClose').setAttribute('aria-label','Close Slayers Hall');document.getElementById('adventureText').innerHTML=art+'<div class="slayerCopy">'+questEscape(text).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</div>';panel.querySelector('.screenFoot').textContent='Accepted hunts save with this character. Turn in rewards at any Slayers Hall.';}
function slayerCrest(){return '<svg class="slayerCrest" viewBox="0 0 80 80" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40 5 68 16v24c0 17-15 28-28 35C27 68 12 57 12 40V16Z" fill="#25332b" stroke="#cba65d" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m24 22 31 35m0-35L24 57m-5-8 13 12m16 0 13-12" stroke="#e6d1a0" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="40" cy="35" r="8" fill="#cba65d"/><path d="M36 33h2m4 0h2m-8 7h8" stroke="#25332b" stroke-width="3"/></svg>'}
function slayerHeader(){const st=slayerState(),rank=slayerRank(),next=slayerRanks.find(r=>r.marks>st.marks),pct=next?Math.round((st.marks-rank.marks)/(next.marks-rank.marks)*100):100;return '<div class="slayerHeader">'+slayerCrest()+'<div><span class="slayerEyebrow">THE HUNTERS’ LEDGER</span><h3>'+rank.name+'</h3><p>'+st.marks+' Slayer Marks · '+st.completed+' contracts cleared</p></div></div><div class="slayerRankTrack" role="progressbar" aria-label="Hall rank progress" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="'+pct+'"><i style="width:'+pct+'%"></i></div><p class="slayerRankHint">'+(next?(next.marks-st.marks)+' marks to '+next.name+' · Rank reward: '+next.bonus+' crowns':'Master rank earned · The hall remembers your deeds')+'</p>'}
function openSlayersHall(){if(!atSlayersHall())return;const st=slayerState();if(!st.joined){st.joined=true;saveGame()}const active=slayerActive(),ready=active.filter(([id,h])=>h.kills>=h.target).length;slayerPanel('“Find the beast. Finish the hunt. Bring the road home safe.” — Warden Rook\n\nChoose up to three contracts. Only kills after acceptance count; your companions can help. Completed hunts earn crowns, XP, and permanent Slayer Marks.\n\n'+(active.length?active.length+'/3 hunts active'+(ready?' · '+ready+' ready for reward.':'.'):'Your ledger is empty. Take a contract from the board.'),[{label:'Browse hunting contracts',action:()=>openSlayerBoard(0)},{label:'Active hunts · '+active.length+'/3',disabled:!active.length,action:openSlayerActive},{label:'Hall ranks & rewards',action:openSlayerRanks},{label:'Leave the hall',action:()=>{}}],slayerHeader());}
function slayerContractCard(id){const d=slayerContracts[id],h=slayerHunt(id),active=!!h?.accepted,t=active?h:slayerTerms(id),ready=active&&h.kills>=h.target,pct=active?Math.round(Math.min(h.kills,t.target)/t.target*100):0;return '<article class="slayerContract '+(ready?'slayerReady':'')+'"><div class="slayerContractTop"><span>'+ (ready?'READY TO TURN IN':active?'ACTIVE HUNT':'LEVEL '+d.level+'+')+'</span><span>'+ (h?.completed?'Cleared '+h.completed+'×':'First contract')+'</span></div><h3>'+d.title+'</h3><p>'+d.monster+' · '+maps[d.area].name+'</p><div class="slayerContractMeter"><i style="width:'+pct+'%"></i></div><p class="slayerContractGoal">'+(active?h.kills+' / '+t.target+' defeated':'Hunt '+t.target+' monsters')+'</p><p class="slayerContractReward">'+slayerRewardText(t)+'</p></article>'}
function openSlayerBoard(page=0){const ids=Object.keys(slayerContracts),pages=Math.ceil(ids.length/3);page=clamp(Math.floor(Number(page)||0),0,pages-1);const shown=ids.slice(page*3,page*3+3);slayerPanel('CONTRACT BOARD · Page '+(page+1)+' of '+pages+'\nInspect a contract for its hunting grounds, rules, and rewards.',[...shown.map(id=>({label:slayerContracts[id].title+' · Inspect',action:()=>openSlayerContract(id)})),...(page>0?[{label:'Previous contracts',action:()=>openSlayerBoard(page-1)}]:[]),...(page<pages-1?[{label:'More contracts',action:()=>openSlayerBoard(page+1)}]:[]),{label:'Back to the hall',action:openSlayersHall}],'<div class="slayerBoard">'+shown.map(slayerContractCard).join('')+'</div>');}
function openSlayerActive(){const active=slayerActive();if(!active.length){openSlayersHall();return}slayerPanel('YOUR ACTIVE HUNTS\nReturn here when the ledger says ready. You may turn in at any town’s hall.',[...active.map(([id,h])=>({label:slayerContracts[id].title+(h.kills>=h.target?' · Claim reward':' · View hunt'),action:()=>openSlayerContract(id)})),{label:'Back to the hall',action:openSlayersHall}],'<div class="slayerBoard">'+active.map(([id])=>slayerContractCard(id)).join('')+'</div>');}
function openSlayerContract(id){const d=slayerContracts[id];if(!d||!atSlayersHall())return;const h=slayerHunt(id),active=!!h?.accepted,ready=active&&h.kills>=h.target,t=active?h:slayerTerms(id),full=slayerActive().length>=3,locked=player.level<d.level;const choices=active?[...(ready?[{label:'Claim · '+slayerRewardText(t),action:()=>claimSlayerContract(id)}]:[{label:'Track this hunt',action:()=>{townQuestState._tracking={id:'slayer_'+id};saveGame();ui();say('Tracking '+d.title+'.');}},{label:'Show hunting grounds on map',action:()=>{openTravelScreen();markQuestDestination('slayer_'+id)}}]),{label:'Abandon hunt',action:()=>confirmAbandonSlayer(id)}]:[{label:locked?'Unlocks at level '+d.level:full?'Your ledger is full · 3 active hunts':'Accept hunt · '+t.target+' monsters',disabled:locked||full,action:()=>acceptSlayerContract(id)}];slayerPanel(d.title.toUpperCase()+'\nHunting grounds: '+maps[d.area].name+' · Level '+d.level+'+\n'+d.hint+'\n\n'+(active?(ready?'The contract is complete. Claim your reward below.':'Defeat '+Math.max(0,h.target-h.kills)+' more '+d.monster+'. Kills by your active party count.'):'Defeat '+t.target+' '+d.monster+' in this region after accepting. Previous kills do not count. Accepting will track this hunt.')+'\n\nRepeat contracts ask for two more monsters per clear, up to five increases, with higher crown and XP rewards. Marks build permanent hall rank.',[...choices,{label:'Back to the hall',action:openSlayersHall}],slayerContractCard(id));}
function acceptSlayerContract(id){const d=slayerContracts[id];if(!d||!atSlayersHall()||player.level<d.level||slayerHunt(id)?.accepted||slayerActive().length>=3)return false;const st=slayerState(),old=slayerHunt(id),t=slayerTerms(id);st.joined=true;st.hunts[id]={...t,accepted:true,kills:0,completed:old?.completed||0,acceptedAt:Date.now()};townQuestState._tracking={id:'slayer_'+id};saveGame();ui();openSlayerContract(id);return true;}
function claimSlayerContract(id){const d=slayerContracts[id],h=slayerHunt(id);if(!d||!atSlayersHall()||!h?.accepted||h.kills<h.target)return false;const st=slayerState();h.accepted=false;h.completed=(h.completed||0)+1;st.completed++;st.marks+=h.marks;player.coins+=h.coins;grantXp(h.xp);let bonus=0;for(const r of slayerRanks)if(r.bonus&&st.marks>=r.marks&&!st.rankRewards.includes(r.name)){st.rankRewards.push(r.name);bonus+=r.bonus}player.coins+=bonus;if(trackedQuestId()==='slayer_'+id)delete townQuestState._tracking;saveGame();ui();playSfx('quest');slayerPanel('CONTRACT CLEARED · '+d.title+'\n'+slayerRewardText(h)+(bonus?'\nRank reward: +'+bonus+' crowns · '+slayerRank().name+'!':'')+'\n\nYour reward is saved. A harder version of this contract is now on the board.',[{label:'Browse more contracts',action:()=>openSlayerBoard(0)},{label:'Back to the hall',action:openSlayersHall}],slayerHeader());return true;}
function confirmAbandonSlayer(id){const h=slayerHunt(id);if(!slayerContracts[id]||!h?.accepted)return;slayerPanel('Abandon '+slayerContracts[id].title+'?\nYour '+h.kills+' recorded kills will be lost. No fee is charged; you may accept it again and start fresh.',[{label:'Keep hunting',action:()=>openSlayerContract(id)},{label:'Abandon · Lose progress',action:()=>abandonSlayerContract(id)}]);}
function abandonSlayerContract(id){const h=slayerHunt(id);if(!slayerContracts[id]||!atSlayersHall()||!h?.accepted)return false;h.accepted=false;h.kills=0;if(trackedQuestId()==='slayer_'+id)delete townQuestState._tracking;saveGame();ui();openSlayersHall();return true;}
function slayerTarget(area,e){return !!townQuestState._slayers&&slayerActive().some(([id,h])=>h.kills<h.target&&slayerContracts[id].area===area&&slayerContracts[id].kind===e.kind)}
function recordSlayerKill(area,e){if(!townQuestState._slayers||!e||e.alive||maps[area]?.town)return;let changed=false;for(const [id,h] of slayerActive()){const d=slayerContracts[id];if(h.kills>=h.target||d.area!==area||d.kind!==e.kind)continue;h.kills=Math.min(h.target,h.kills+1);changed=true;}if(changed)saveGame();}

Each new rank pays its crown reward once when you turn in a hunt.',[{label:'Back to the hall',action:openSlayersHall}],slayerHeader()+'<div class="slayerRanks">'+slayerRanks.map(r=>'<div><b>'+r.name+'</b><span>'+r.marks+' marks · '+(r.bonus?r.bonus+' crown reward':'Starting rank')+(slayerState().marks>=r.marks?' · Earned':'')+'</span></div>').join('')+'</div>');}

'+d.hint+' Return to any town’s hall for your reward.',reward:'Reward: '+slayerRewardText(h),done:false,active:true})}return rows;}

function worldQuestState(id){return townQuestState[id]||(townQuestState[id]={accepted:false,claimed:false,progress:0})}
function completeWorldQuest(id){const q=worldQuestDefs[id],st=worldQuestState(id);if(st.claimed){say('You already received this reward.');return true}if(!addItem(q.item)){say('Your pack is full. Make room, then collect '+itemDefs[q.item].name+'.');return true}st.claimed=true;player.coins+=q.coins;grantXp(q.xp);playSfx('quest');say(q.title+' complete · '+itemDefs[q.item].name+' · +'+q.coins+' crowns · +'+q.xp+' XP');ui();saveGame();return true}
function worldObjectInteract(obj){
 if(obj.id.startsWith("wayfarer_"))return interactWayfarer(obj);
 if(obj.id.startsWith("regional_"))return regionalInteract(obj);
 if(obj.id.startsWith("practice_")){openFieldGuide();return true;}
 if(interactAdventureObject(obj))return true;
 if(obj.id.startsWith('armory_'))return interactClassArmory(obj.hero);
 if(obj.id.startsWith('gear_waystone_'))return interactGearWaystone(obj);
 if(obj.id==='tower_tablet'){const st=worldQuestState('world_watchtower');st.accepted=true;say(st.claimed?'The watchtower beacons shine again.':'Tablet: At dawn face EAST, at dusk turn WEST, then look NORTH. Light the beacons in that order; the cache will open.');saveGame();return true}
 if(obj.id.startsWith('beacon_')){const st=worldQuestState('world_watchtower');if(st.claimed||st.progress>=3){say('All three beacons are lit. The cache is unlocked.');return true}if(!st.accepted){say('Read the tablet beside the road first.');return true}const order=['beacon_east','beacon_west','beacon_north'];if(obj.id===order[st.progress]){st.progress++;say(st.progress===3?'The three beacons blaze. Open the watchtower cache.':'Beacon lit · '+st.progress+'/3.')}else{st.progress=0;say('Wrong order. The beacons go dark. Read the tablet and try again.')}saveGame();return true}
 if(obj.id==='tower_cache'){const st=worldQuestState('world_watchtower');if(st.progress<3&&!st.claimed){say('The cache is sealed. Read the tablet and light the three beacons.');return true}return completeWorldQuest('world_watchtower')}
 if(obj.id==='rescue_notice'){const st=worldQuestState('world_rescue');st.accepted=true;say(st.claimed?'The traveler made it home safely.':'A traveler is held in this camp. Defeat its four guards, then INTERACT at the cage to free them.');saveGame();return true}
 if(obj.id==='prisoner_cage'){const st=worldQuestState('world_rescue');st.accepted=true;if(st.claimed){say('The cage is empty. The traveler is safe.');return true}const left=maps.meadowroad.enemies.filter(e=>e.worldBandit&&e.alive).length;if(left){say('The traveler: '+left+' camp guard'+(left===1?'':'s')+' still hold the key. Defeat them first.');saveGame();return true}st.rescued=true;return completeWorldQuest('world_rescue')}
 return false;
}

function bulkSellPlan(){const rows=[];for(const row of player.inventory){const d=itemDefs[row.id];if(!d?.sell||!['gear','material'].includes(d.category))continue;const keep=d.category==='gear'&&GEAR_SLOTS.some(slot=>player[slot]===row.id)?1:0,count=Math.max(0,row.count-keep);if(count)rows.push({id:row.id,count,value:count*d.sell});}return {rows,count:rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.count,0),crowns:rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.value,0)};}
let bulkSellReview=null;
function renderBulkSell(){const host=document.getElementById('bulkSellBar');host.hidden=shopMode!=='sell';if(host.hidden){bulkSellReview=null;return;}const plan=bulkSellPlan();host.innerHTML=bulkSellReview?'<span>Sell '+bulkSellReview.count+' spare items for '+bulkSellReview.crowns+' crowns? Equipped gear, tools, supplies, and quest items stay in your bag.</span><div><button type="button" data-shop-action="confirm-sell-all">Confirm sale</button><button type="button" data-shop-action="cancel-sell-all">Cancel</button></div>':'<span>Sell spare gear and materials. Equipped gear, tools, supplies, and quest items are protected.</span><button type="button" data-shop-action="sell-all" '+(plan.count?'':'disabled')+'>Sell all · '+plan.count+' items · '+plan.crowns+' crowns</button>';}
function reviewSellAll(){const plan=bulkSellPlan();if(!plan.count){document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='No spare gear or materials to sell.';return;}bulkSellReview=plan;renderBulkSell();}
function confirmSellAll(){if(!bulkSellReview)return;const plan=bulkSellPlan();if(JSON.stringify(plan)!==JSON.stringify(bulkSellReview)){bulkSellReview=null;renderBulkSell();document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Your bag changed. Review Sell all again.';return;}for(const row of plan.rows)removeItem(row.id,row.count);player.coins+=plan.crowns;bulkSellReview=null;saveGame();ui();renderShop();document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Sold '+plan.count+' spare items for '+plan.crowns+' crowns.';}

function craftSetGear(id){const shop=shopDefs[activeShopId],d=itemDefs[id],cost=d&&setCraftCosts[d.tier];if(!shop?.forgeClass||!d||d.set!==shop.forgeClass||d.tier<3||Object.values(classGearQuests).some(q=>q.item===id))return;if(player.level<GEAR_TIERS[d.tier].level){document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Requires level '+GEAR_TIERS[d.tier].level+'.';return;}if(bagUnits()>=bagLimit()){document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Make room in your bag before crafting.';return;}if(player.coins<cost.coins||Object.entries(cost.materials).some(([mat,n])=>bagCount(mat)<n)){document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Gather the listed materials and crowns first.';return;}if(!addItem(id))return;for(const [mat,n] of Object.entries(cost.materials))removeItem(mat,n);player.coins-=cost.coins;saveGame();ui();renderShop();document.getElementById('shopNotice').textContent='Crafted '+d.name+'.';}

function classGearQuestDetail(q){return q.type==='hunt'?'Defeat '+q.target+' '+(q.kind==='slime'?'slimes':q.kind==='spider'?'spiders':'skeletons')+' in '+maps[q.area].name+'.':q.type==='gather'?'Gather successfully '+q.target+' times using '+q.skill+' in '+maps[q.area].name+'. Buy the matching tool at a town shop.':'Activate the '+classDefs[q.hero].title+' waystones in '+q.regions.map(id=>maps[id].name).join(', ')+'.'}
function recordClassGearProgress(type,area,kind){let changed=false;for(const [id,q] of Object.entries(classGearQuests)){const st=townQuestState[id];if(!st?.accepted||st.claimed||q.type!==type||q.area!==area||(type==='hunt'?q.kind!==kind:q.skill!==kind))continue;st.progress=Math.min(q.target,(st.progress||0)+1);changed=true;}if(changed)saveGame()}
function interactClassArmory(hero){
 const quests=Object.entries(classGearQuests).filter(([,q])=>q.hero===hero),next=quests.find(([id])=>!townQuestState[id]?.claimed);
 if(!next){say(classDefs[hero].title+' armory: You have earned all three unique items.');return true}
 const [id,q]=next,st=worldQuestState(id);
 if(!st.accepted){st.accepted=true;st.progress=0;st.waystones=[];say(q.title+' accepted. '+classGearQuestDetail(q));saveGame();return true}
 const progress=q.type==='waystones'?(st.waystones||[]).length:st.progress||0;
 if(progress<q.target){say(q.title+' · '+progress+'/'+q.target+'. '+classGearQuestDetail(q));return true}
 if(!addItem(q.item)){say('Your pack is full. Make room, then return for '+itemDefs[q.item].name+'.');return true}

function interactAdventureObject(obj){
 if(obj.id==='campaign_chronicle'){openCampaignChronicle();return true}
 if(obj.id.startsWith('story_portal_')){const id=obj.dungeon,locked=storyPortalLock(id);if(locked){say(locked);return true}return takeMapExit({trigger:'interact',to:id,entry:'default'})}
 if(obj.id.startsWith('story_ward_')){const st=storyState(obj.dungeon);st.wards=Array.isArray(st.wards)?st.wards:[];if(!st.wards.includes(obj.index))st.wards.push(obj.index);say(obj.label+' disabled · '+st.wards.length+'/2.');saveGame();return true}
 if(obj.id.startsWith('story_cache_'))return collectStoryCache(obj.dungeon);
 if(obj.id.startsWith('story_replay_'))return resetStoryChallenge(obj.dungeon);
 if(obj.id.startsWith('epilogue_'))return interactEpilogue(obj.companion);
 if(obj.id==='crossroads_medicine')return interactMedicine();
 if(obj.id.startsWith('secret_')){const st=worldQuestState(obj.id);if(st.claimed){say('This hidden cache is empty.');return true}if(!addItem('ancient_alloy')){say('Make room for the Ancient Alloy in this cache.');return true}st.claimed=true;player.coins+=30;grantXp(20);say('Hidden trail cache · Ancient Alloy · +30 crowns · +20 XP.');ui();saveGame();return true}
 return false;
}

// Dan is the testing profile: preserve earned levels and grant a maxed class set.
function applyDanTestProfile(){
 return false; // Test profile grants are disabled in the public build.
 if(String(player.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()!=='dan')return false;
 const profile=classGearProfiles[player.class];if(!profile)return false;
 const ratio=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(Number(player.hp)||1)/Math.max(1,Number(player.max)||1)));
 player.level=Math.max(100,Math.floor(Number(player.level)||1));
 player.max=Math.max(Number(player.max)||1,classDefs[player.class].hp+(player.level-1)*10);
 player.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(player.max*ratio));
 for(const skill of Object.values(gatheringSkills)){skill.level=10;skill.xp=450}
 if(!Array.isArray(player.inventory))player.inventory=[];
 for(const [i,id] of profile.items.entries()){
  const row=player.inventory.find(item=>item.id===id);if(row)row.count=Math.max(1,Number(row.count)||0);else player.inventory.push({id,count:1});
  gearUpgradeLevels[id]=gearUpgradeCap(id);player[['weapon','armor','shield'][i]]=id;
 }
 for(const slot of GEAR_SLOTS){const id=setGearId(player.class,5,slot);if(!player.inventory.some(row=>row.id===id))player.inventory.push({id,count:1});player[slot]=id;gearUpgradeLevels[id]=gearUpgradeCap(id);}for(const c of companions)applyDanCompanionGear(c);
 scaleEnemiesForPlayer();return true;
}

}
function introState(){return townQuestState._intro||(townQuestState._intro={hits:0,skill:false,skip:false})}
function practiceTarget(){return activeMap.town?(activeMap.worldObjects||[]).find(o=>o.id.startsWith('practice_')&&Math.hypot(o.x-player.x,o.y-player.y)<=Math.max(75,classDefs[player.class].range)):null}
function practiceStrike(skill=false){const obj=practiceTarget();if(!obj)return false;const st=introState();if(skill)st.skill=true;else st.hits=Math.min(3,(st.hits||0)+1);player.attack=.32;player.faceX=(obj.x-player.x)/(Math.hypot(obj.x-player.x,obj.y-player.y)||1);player.faceY=(obj.y-player.y)/(Math.hypot(obj.x-player.x,obj.y-player.y)||1);battleVfx(skill?'Wind':'Explosion',obj.x,obj.y-20,skill?95:45);combatText(obj.x,obj.y-55,skill?'SKILL!':'HIT','#ffe08a');if(st.hits>=3&&st.skill&&!st.rewarded){st.rewarded=true;const gift=addItem('health_tonic',1);if(!gift)player.coins+=8;say('Practice complete. '+(gift?'A Health Tonic is in your bag.':'Your bag is full; you receive 8 crowns instead.')+' Open MAPS → Whisperwood Trail for your First Hunt.')}ui();saveGame();return true}

Your First Hunt is three Ash Slimes in Whisperwood; its reward is automatic.',[{label:activeMap.town?'Practice in town':'Continue exploring',action:()=>{if(activeMap.town){const o=(activeMap.worldObjects||[]).find(o=>o.id.startsWith('practice_'));if(o)tapTarget=safeMapPosition(mapId,o.x-65,o.y,player.r)}}},{label:'Open map for the First Hunt',action:()=>{st.skip=true;saveGame();openTravelScreen()}}]);}

function sceneryRect(x,y,kind){return kind==='tree'?[x-32,y-36,x+32,y+28]:kind==='water'?[x-52,y-32,x+52,y+32]:[x-20,y-20,x+20,y+20]}
function rectsOverlap(a,b){return a[0]<b[2]&&a[2]>b[0]&&a[1]<b[3]&&a[3]>b[1]}
for(const id of ['ashvale','brackenford','stonewatch','sunmere']){
 const town=maps[id],reserved=townSceneryAreas(town);
 for(const [kind,points] of [['water',fishingSpotCoords[id]||[]],['tree',town.trees],['rock',town.stones]])for(const point of points){
  const clear=(x,y)=>!reserved.some(area=>rectsOverlap(sceneryRect(x,y,kind),area));
  if(!clear(...point)){
   let best=null,distance=Infinity;
   for(let y=-250;y<=850;y+=40)for(let x=-430;x<=1390;x+=40){const d=Math.hypot(x-point[0],y-point[1]);if(d<distance&&clear(x,y)){best=[x,y];distance=d}}
   if(!best)throw new Error('No clear town scenery space: '+id);point[0]=best[0];point[1]=best[1];
  }
  reserved.push(sceneryRect(...point,kind));
 }
}
for(const id of Object.keys(maps).filter(id=>!maps[id].town&&maps[id].worldObjects?.length)){

  if(areas.some(a=>rectsOverlap(sceneryRect(...p,kind),a))){let spot=null,dist=Infinity;for(let y=-230;y<=830;y+=40)for(let x=-410;x<=1370;x+=40){const d=Math.hypot(x-p[0],y-p[1]);if(d<dist&&!areas.some(a=>rectsOverlap(sceneryRect(x,y,kind),a))){spot=[x,y];dist=d}}if(!spot)throw Error('No landmark scenery space');p[0]=spot[0];p[1]=spot[1]}
  areas.push(sceneryRect(...p,kind));
 }
}

function fixedSceneryAreas(id){

 if(maps[id].landmark==='watchtower')out.push([415,76,545,240]);
 if(maps[id].landmark==='bandit_camp')out.push([260,120,405,210],[560,100,705,190],[710,145,790,235]);
 return out;
}
function mapPlacementBlocked(id,x,y,r=14){
 const m=maps[id],outdoor=usesOpenWorld(id);
 const b=worldBounds(id);
 if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<b.minX||x>b.maxX||y<b.minY||y>b.maxY)return true;
 if(storyDungeons[id]&&(x<68+r||x>892-r||y<76+r||(y>524-r&&Math.abs(x-480)>40-r)))return true;
 for(const [tx,ty] of m.trees||[])if(Math.hypot(x-tx,y-ty)<r+20)return true;
 for(const [tx,ty] of m.stones||[])if(Math.hypot(x-tx,y-ty)<r+14)return true;
 const areas=fixedSceneryAreas(id);
 if(m.interior){if(x<62+r||x>898-r||y<72+r||(y>528-r&&Math.abs(x-490)>25-r))return true;areas.push([638,120,792,312],[164,178,216,210],[799,183,851,215],[365,80,435,170]);}
 if(m.town){const used=new Set(m.npcs.map(n=>n.frontage));used.add('classHome');for(const key of used){const f=townFrontages[key];if(f)areas.push([f.x,f.y,f.x+f.w,f.y+f.h-6])}for(const [x,y,w,h] of townOutlyingHouses)areas.push([x,y,x+w,y+h]);areas.push([623,174,677,225],[252,265,322,305],[646,265,714,305]);}
 if(areas.some(a=>x>a[0]-r&&x<a[2]+r&&y>a[1]-r&&y<a[3]+r))return true;
 for(const [px,py,rx,ry] of [...(marshSceneryPools[id]||[]),...(fishingSpotCoords[id]||[]).map(p=>[...p,48,28])])if(((x-px)/(rx+r+3))**2+((y-py)/(ry+r+3))**2<1)return true;
 return false;
}
function safeMapPosition(id,x,y,r=14,occupied=[]){
 const free=(px,py)=>!mapPlacementBlocked(id,px,py,r)&&!occupied.some(p=>Math.hypot(px-p.x,py-p.y)<50);
 if(free(x,y))return {x,y};
 for(let radius=16;radius<=2200;radius+=16)for(let i=0;i<32;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/16,px=x+Math.cos(a)*radius,py=y+Math.sin(a)*radius;if(free(px,py))return {x:px,y:py};}
 throw Error('No safe placement in '+id);
}

function placeOutdoorScenery(){
 for(const [id,m] of Object.entries(maps)){
  if(m.town||m.interior||m.dungeon||storyDungeons[id]||['mosslight','emberdeep'].includes(id))continue;
  const expanded=worldGrid.flat().includes(id),limits=expanded?[-930,-550,1890,1160]:[32,42,928,558];const reserved=outdoorRoadAreas().concat(fixedSceneryAreas(id));
  for(const obj of m.worldObjects||[]){const portal=obj.id.startsWith('story_portal_');reserved.push([obj.x-(portal?115:obj.piece!==undefined?22:obj.region?32:50),obj.y-(portal?132:obj.piece!==undefined?44:obj.region?64:80),obj.x+(portal?115:obj.piece!==undefined?22:obj.region?32:50),obj.y+(obj.region?16:35)])}
  if(m.landmark==='watchtower')reserved.push([390,65,575,255]);
  if(m.landmark==='bandit_camp')reserved.push([245,90,415,220],[545,70,720,210],[700,130,800,255]);
  const place=(point,rx,above,below)=>{
   const footprint=(x,y)=>[x-rx,y-above,x+rx,y+below];
   const clear=(x,y)=>x-rx>=limits[0]&&x+rx<=limits[2]&&y-above>=limits[1]&&y+below<=limits[3]&&!reserved.some(a=>rectsOverlap(footprint(x,y),a));
   if(!clear(point[0],point[1])){
    let best=null,distance=Infinity;
    for(let y=limits[1]+above;y<=limits[3]-below;y+=20)for(let x=limits[0]+rx;x<=limits[2]-rx;x+=20){const d=Math.hypot(x-point[0],y-point[1]);if(d<distance&&clear(x,y)){distance=d;best=[x,y]}}
    if(!best)throw Error('No clear outdoor scenery space: '+id);point[0]=best[0];point[1]=best[1];
   }
   reserved.push(footprint(point[0],point[1]));
  };
  for(const p of marshSceneryPools[id]||[])place(p,p[2]*1.07+8,p[3]*1.07+8,p[3]*1.07+18);
  for(const p of fishingSpotCoords[id]||[])place(p,60,38,42);
  for(const p of m.trees||[])place(p,38,42,34);
  for(const p of m.stones||[])place(p,25,25,25);
 }
}

function scaleEnemiesForPlayer(){for(const e of enemies){const oldMax=Math.max(1,e.maxHp||e.baseHp||e.hp||1),nextMax=enemyMaxForLevel(e,activeMap.level);if(e.alive&&nextMax!==oldMax)e.hp=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((e.hp/oldMax)*nextMax));e.maxHp=nextMax}}
function enemyAttackDamage(){const region=Math.max(1,activeMap.level||1),gap=Math.max(0,(player.level||1)-region);return 7+Math.floor((region-1)*1.35)+Math.floor(gap/3)}
function snapCompanionsToPlayer(){const formation=[[-68,38],[68,38],[0,108]],bounds=worldBounds();activeCompanions().forEach((c,index)=>{if(c.hp<=0)return;const [ox,oy]=formation[index];Object.assign(c,safeMapPosition(mapId,clamp(player.x+ox,bounds.minX+18,bounds.maxX-18),clamp(player.y+oy,bounds.minY+28,bounds.maxY-18),14,[player,...activeCompanions().slice(0,index)]))})}
function interactCompanion(n){const id=n.companionId,def=companionDefs[id];if(!def)return false;let c=companions.find(x=>x.id===id);if(c){if(c.active){selectedCompanionId=id;openPartyScreen();return true}if(c.hp<=0){say(c.name+' needs a healer before returning to the party.');return true}if(activeCompanions().length>=3){say('Your party is full. Bench a companion in the PARTY screen first.');return true}c.active=true;selectedCompanionId=id;say(c.name+' rejoins your party.');saveGame();ui();return true}if(activeCompanions().length>=3){say('Your party is full. Bench a companion in the PARTY screen first.');return true}if(player.coins<def.cost){say(n.name+' asks for '+def.cost+' crowns to join.');return true}player.coins-=def.cost;c=makeCompanion(id);companions.push(c);selectedCompanionId=id;say(c.name+' joined your party · -'+def.cost+' crowns.');saveGame();ui();return true}
function openPartyScreen(){preparePanel('partyScreen');keys.clear();saveFilesScreen.hidden=true;characterScreen.hidden=true;inventoryScreen.hidden=true;shopScreen.hidden=true;storageScreen.hidden=true;questScreen.hidden=true;document.getElementById('gameView').hidden=true;document.getElementById('controlRow').hidden=true;partyScreen.hidden=false;renderParty();refreshPanelState()}
function companionCanUse(id,c){return gearRequirements(id,c)}

here.</div>';document.getElementById('partyGearTitle').textContent='COMPANION EQUIPMENT';return}if(!companions.some(c=>c.id===selectedCompanionId))selectedCompanionId=companions[0].id;const class="partyMemberHead"><strong>'+c.name+'</strong><span>'+classDefs[c.class].title+' · Lv '+c.level+'</span></div><div>Vitality '+c.hp+' / '+c.max+' · XP '+c.xp+' / 40 · data-party-active="'+c.id+'">'+(c.active?'Bench':'Bring along')+'</button></div></article>').join('');document.getElementById('partyGearTitle').textContent=selected.name+' · '+classDefs[selected.class].title+' · '+equipmentSetSummary(selected);const equippedSlots=GEAR_SLOTS;slots.innerHTML=equippedSlots.map(slot=>{const id=selected[slot],item=id?itemDefs[id]:null;return '<div class="partyEquipSlot"><span><strong>'+GEAR_LABELS[slot]+':</strong> '+(item?item.icon+' '+item.name:'Empty')+'</span>'+(item?'<button type="button" data-party-unequip="'+slot+'">Unequip</button>':'')+'</div>'}).join('');const rows=player.inventory.filter(row=>itemDefs[row.id]&&itemDefs[row.id].slot);gear.innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(row=>{const item=itemDefs[row.id],allowed=companionCanUse(row.id,selected),equipped=selected[item.slot]===row.id;return '<article class="itemRow"><div class="itemInfo"><div class="itemName">'+item.icon+' '+item.name+' <span class="itemCount">× '+row.count+'</span></div><div class="itemDescription">'+(item.description||'')+' · '+(allowed?'For '+classDefs[selected.class].title:'Requires '+itemClassNames(row.id))+'</div></div><div class="itemActions"><button type="button" class="itemAction buy" data-party-equip="'+row.id+'" '+(!allowed||equipped?'disabled':'')+'>'+(equipped?'Equipped':allowed?'Equip':'Requirements unmet')+'</button></div></article>'}).join(''):'<div class="emptyInventory">No gear in your bag. Visit a town smith to buy equipment.</div>'}
function equipCompanionItem(id){
 const c=companions.find(x=>x.id===selectedCompanionId),item=itemDefs[id];
 if(!c||!item||!GEAR_SLOTS.includes(item.slot)||!bagCount(id))return;
 if(!companionCanUse(id,c)){renderParty(item.name+' requires '+itemClassNames(id)+' · level '+(item.minLevel||1)+'.');return}
 const previous=c[item.slot];if(previous===id)return;
 if(!removeItem(id,1))return;
 if(previous){const row=player.inventory.find(x=>x.id===previous);if(row)row.count++;else player.inventory.push({id:previous,count:1})}
 if(player[item.slot]===id&&!bagCount(id))player[item.slot]=null;
 c[item.slot]=id;saveGame();renderParty(c.name+' equipped '+item.name+'.');
}
function unequipCompanionItem(slot){const c=companions.find(x=>x.id===selectedCompanionId);if(!c||!GEAR_SLOTS.includes(slot)||!c[slot])return;if(!addItem(c[slot])){document.getElementById('partyNotice').textContent='Your pack is full.';return}c[slot]=null;saveGame();renderParty('Gear returned to your bag.')}
function setCompanionActive(id){const c=companions.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!c)return;if(c.active){c.active=false;renderParty(c.name+' is resting at the current town.')}else if(activeCompanions().length>=3){renderParty('Your party cannot have more than three active companions.');return}else{c.active=true;selectedCompanionId=id;renderParty(c.name+' joined the traveling party.')}saveGame()}
function bindPartyControl(event){const button=event.target.closest('[data-party-select],[data-party-active],[data-party-equip],[data-party-unequip]');if(!button||button.disabled||!partyScreen.contains(button))return;if(button.dataset.partySelect){selectedCompanionId=button.dataset.partySelect;renderParty()}else if(button.dataset.partyActive)setCompanionActive(button.dataset.partyActive);else if(button.dataset.partyEquip)equipCompanionItem(button.dataset.partyEquip);else if(button.dataset.partyUnequip)unequipCompanionItem(button.dataset.partyUnequip)}

function useCompanionSkill(c,dt){c.skillCool=Math.max(0,(c.skillCool||0)-dt);if(c.hp<=0||activeMap.town||c.skillCool>0)return;const targets=enemies.filter(e=>e.alive&&Math.hypot(e.x-c.x,e.y-c.y)<(c.class==='mage'?210:90)&&clearCombatLine(c.x,c.y,e.x,e.y)),power=companionAttackPower(c);const allies=[player,...activeCompanions()].filter(a=>a.hp>0&&Math.hypot(a.x-c.x,a.y-c.y)<150);if(c.class==='cleric'){if(!allies.some(a=>a.hp<a.max*.75))return;for(const a of allies){const heal=Math.min(a.max-a.hp,Math.max(25,Math.ceil(a.max*.25)));a.hp+=heal;if(heal)combatText(a.x,a.y-28,'+'+heal,'#a6edac')}combatEffects.push({x:c.x,y:c.y,radius:110,color:'#a6edac',life:.45})}else{if(!targets.length)return;targets.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-c.x,a.y-c.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-c.x,b.y-c.y));const target=targets[0];let victims=c.class==='warrior'?targets:c.class==='mage'?enemies.filter(e=>e.alive&&Math.hypot(e.x-target.x,e.y-target.y)<75&&clearCombatLine(target.x,target.y,e.x,e.y)):[target];for(const e of victims){const damage=power*(c.class==='rogue'?4:c.class==='mage'?3:2);damageEnemy(e,damage,c.class==='warrior'?.9:0,c)}combatEffects.push({x:c.class==='mage'?target.x:c.x,y:c.class==='mage'?target.y:c.y,radius:c.class==='mage'?75:65,color:'#d9d192',life:.45})}battleVfx(c.class==='mage'?'Fire_Ball':c.class==='cleric'?'Portal':'Wind',c.class==='mage'?targets[0].x:c.x,c.class==='mage'?targets[0].y-20:c.y-20,110);c.castTime=.48;c.skillCool=combatSkills[c.class].cool;c.cool=Math.max(c.cool||0,.4);c.attack=.32;playSfx('attack');ui();saveGame()}

function updateCompanions(dt){
 const active=activeCompanions(),formation=[[-68,38],[68,38],[0,108]],bounds=worldBounds();
 active.forEach((c,index)=>{c.cool=Math.max(0,(c.cool||0)-dt);c.attack=Math.max(0,(c.attack||0)-dt);if(c.hp<=0)return;const [ox,oy]=formation[index],def=classDefs[c.class];let target=null,best=220;
 if(!activeMap.town)for(const e of enemies){const d=Math.hypot(e.x-c.x,e.y-c.y);if(e.alive&&Math.hypot(e.x-player.x,e.y-player.y)<240&&d<best){best=d;target=e}}
 let tx=player.x+ox,ty=player.y+oy;
 if(target){const angle=Math.atan2(c.y-target.y,c.x-target.x)+(index-1)*.15,distance=c.class==='mage'?125:c.class==='cleric'?48:40;tx=target.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance;ty=target.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance}
 const warning=enemies.find(e=>e.alive&&e.swing&&e.windup>0&&Math.hypot(c.x-e.swing.x,c.y-e.swing.y)<e.swing.radius+20);
 if(warning){const a=Math.atan2(c.y-warning.swing.y,c.x-warning.swing.x)||((index+1)*2);tx=warning.swing.x+Math.cos(a)*(warning.swing.radius+44);ty=warning.swing.y+Math.sin(a)*(warning.swing.radius+44)}
 tx=clamp(tx,bounds.minX+18,bounds.maxX-18);ty=clamp(ty,bounds.minY+28,bounds.maxY-18);c.moving=steerActor(c,tx,ty,warning?230:190,dt,14);
 for(const other of [player,...active.slice(0,index)])if(Math.hypot(c.x-other.x,c.y-other.y)<30){const d=Math.hypot(c.x-other.x,c.y-other.y)||1,nx=c.x+(c.x-other.x)/d*4,ny=c.y+(c.y-other.y)/d*4;if(!overlaps(nx,ny,14)){c.x=nx;c.y=ny}}
 if(Math.hypot(c.x-player.x,c.y-player.y)>380||overlaps(c.x,c.y,14))Object.assign(c,safeMapPosition(mapId,player.x+ox,player.y+oy,14,[player,...active.slice(0,index)]));
 useCompanionSkill(c,dt);if(!target||warning||c.cool>0||Math.hypot(target.x-c.x,target.y-c.y)>def.range||!clearCombatLine(c.x,c.y,target.x,target.y))return;c.cool=Math.max(.45,def.cooldown*1.35);c.attack=.32;const aim=Math.hypot(target.x-c.x,target.y-c.y)||1;c.faceX=(target.x-c.x)/aim;c.faceY=(target.y-c.y)/aim;damageEnemy(target,companionAttackPower(c),0,c);
 });
}
function finishEnemy(e,killerClass){if(!e.alive)return;playSfx('hit');e.alive=false;e.deathAnim=.6;e.respawnAt=activeMap.respawnMs&&!e.boss&&!e.eventRegion?Date.now()+activeMap.respawnMs:0;if(mapId==='whisperwood'&&!done)defeated++;grantXp(14);player.coins+=3;let loot='';if(!e.lootClaimed){let drops=[];if(mapId==='emberdeep'){const drop=e.kind==='skeleton'?'bone_shard':e.kind==='spider'?'spider_silk':e.boss?'warden_crest':null;if(drop)drops=[drop]}else{const available=getRegionalDropIds(mapId,e),guaranteed=activeQuestDrops(mapId,e);if(guaranteed.length)drops=guaranteed;else if(available.length&&Math.random()<.35)drops=[available[Math.floor(Math.random()*available.length)]]}const found=drops.filter(id=>addItem(id));if(found.length){e.lootClaimed=true;loot=' · found '+found.map(id=>itemDefs[id].name).join(', ')}}if(e.worldBandit)worldQuestState('world_rescue').accepted=true;recordQuestKill(mapId,e);recordSlayerKill(mapId,e);if(killerClass&&classDefs[killerClass].heal)player.hp=Math.min(player.max,player.hp+classDefs[killerClass].heal);const slain=e.name||(e.kind==='skeleton'?'Vault skeleton':e.kind==='spider'?'Giant ash spider':e.boss?'Cinder Warden':'Ash slime');if(mapId==='whisperwood'&&defeated>=3&&!done){playSfx('quest');done=true;if(!huntRewarded){huntRewarded=true;player.coins+=20;grantXp(20)}say('First Hunt complete · +20 crowns · +20 XP')}else say(slain+' defeated · +14 XP, +3 crowns'+loot);ui();saveGame()}
window.saveGame=saveGame;

function ui(){document.getElementById('hp').style.width=(player.hp/player.max*100)+'%';document.getElementById('hpText').textContent=player.hp+' / '+player.max;document.getElementById('xp').style.width=(player.xp/40*100)+'%';document.getElementById('xpText').textContent=player.xp+' / 40';document.getElementById('level').textContent=player.level;document.getElementById('coins').textContent=player.coins;document.getElementById('progress').textContent=done?(hasFourfoldKey?(hasSigil?(deepQuestDone?'Complete':'Unlock the Ashvault'):'Enter Mosslight Shrine'):'Town seals '+Object.values(townRelicState).filter(Boolean).length+'/4'):(Math.min(defeated,3)+' / 3');document.getElementById('itemPill').hidden=!hasSigil;document.getElementById('keystonePill').hidden=!hasFourfoldKey;document.getElementById('heroName').textContent=player.name;document.getElementById('className').textContent=classDefs[player.class].title;const title=!done?'First Hunt':!hasFourfoldKey?'The Fourfold Keystone':!hasSigil?'The Ember Rune':!deepQuestDone?'Beneath Ashvale':'Ashvale Remembered';const remaining=Math.max(0,3-Math.min(defeated,3)),details=!done?(mapId==='whisperwood'?'Defeat '+remaining+' Ash Slime'+(remaining===1?'':'s')+' on this trail. Your reward is automatic; no NPC turn-in is needed.':'Use MAPS to locate Whisperwood Trail, walk there, and defeat three Ash Slimes.') :!hasFourfoldKey?'Complete both town quests in each of Ashvale, Sunmere, Brackenford, and Stonewatch to earn the four seals.':!hasSigil?'Travel to Mosslight Shrine, solve West → North → East, then open the chest.':!deepQuestDone?'Travel to Ashvault Depths, defeat its guardian, and open the coffer.':'The Ashvault is quiet again.';document.getElementById('questTitle').textContent=title;document.getElementById('questDetails').textContent=details;campaignHud();refreshOpeningGuide();refreshTrackedQuest();saveGame()}

function openQuestJournal(){preparePanel('questScreen');keys.clear();saveFilesScreen.hidden=true;characterScreen.hidden=true;renderQuests();inventoryScreen.hidden=true;shopScreen.hidden=true;document.getElementById('gameView').hidden=true;document.getElementById('controlRow').hidden=true;questScreen.hidden=false;refreshPanelState()}
function bagUnits(){return (player.inventory||[]).reduce((n,row)=>n+(itemDefs[row.id]?.category==='quest'?0:row.count),0)}
function bagCount(id){const row=(player.inventory||[]).find(x=>x.id===id);return row?row.count:0}
function grantQuestArtifact(id){if(!itemDefs[id]||itemDefs[id].category!=='quest')return false;if(!player.inventory.some(row=>row.id===id))player.inventory.push({id,count:1});return true}
function addItem(id,amount=1){if(!itemDefs[id]||bagUnits()+amount>bagLimit())return false;let row=player.inventory.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!row){row={id,count:0};player.inventory.push(row)}row.count+=amount;return true}
function removeItem(id,amount=1){const row=player.inventory.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!row||row.count<amount)return false;row.count-=amount;if(row.count<=0)player.inventory=player.inventory.filter(x=>x.id!==id);return true}
const HOME_CHEST_CAPACITY=24;let activeStorageChest='front_chest';
function storageUnits(id){return (houseStorage[activeStorageHome]?.[id]||[]).reduce((n,row)=>n+(Number(row.count)||0),0)}
function moveToStorage(id){const bag=player.inventory.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!bag)return;if(storageUnits(activeStorageChest)>=HOME_CHEST_CAPACITY){document.getElementById('storageNotice').textContent='This chest is full.';return}if(!removeItem(id,1))return;if(bag.count<=0){for(const slot of GEAR_SLOTS)if(player[slot]===id)player[slot]=null}let stored=houseStorage[activeStorageHome][activeStorageChest].find(x=>x.id===id);if(!stored){stored={id,count:0};houseStorage[activeStorageHome][activeStorageChest].push(stored)}stored.count++;document.getElementById('storageNotice').textContent='Stored '+itemDefs[id].name+'.';saveGame();renderStorage()}
function takeFromStorage(id){const rows=houseStorage[activeStorageHome][activeStorageChest],row=rows.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!row)return;if(bagUnits()>=bagLimit()){document.getElementById('storageNotice').textContent='Your pack is full.';return}if(!addItem(id,1))return;row.count--;if(row.count<=0)houseStorage[activeStorageHome][activeStorageChest]=rows.filter(x=>x.id!==id);document.getElementById('storageNotice').textContent='Moved '+itemDefs[id].name+' to your pack.';saveGame();renderStorage()}
function storageRows(rows,action,disabled){if(!rows.length)return '<div class="emptyInventory">Nothing here yet.</div>';return rows.map(row=>{const item=itemDefs[row.id];if(!item)return '';const label=action==='store'?'Store 1':'Take 1';return '<article class="itemRow"><div class="itemInfo"><div class="itemName">'+item.icon+' '+item.name+' <span class="itemCount">× '+row.count+'</span></div><div class="itemDescription">'+(item.description||'')+'</div></div><div class="itemActions"><button type="button" class="itemAction '+(action==='store'?'buy':'')+'" data-storage-action="'+action+'" data-id="'+row.id+'" '+(disabled?'disabled':'')+'>'+label+'</button></div></article>'}).join('')}
function renderStorage(){const chest=houseStorage[activeStorageHome]?.[activeStorageChest]||[];document.getElementById('storageChestName').textContent=homeDefs[activeStorageHome].name+' · '+(activeStorageChest==='front_chest'?'Front Room Chest':'Side Room Chest');document.getElementById('storageCapacity').textContent=storageUnits(activeStorageChest)+' / '+HOME_CHEST_CAPACITY+' items';document.getElementById('storageChestList').innerHTML=storageRows(chest,'take',bagUnits()>=bagLimit());document.getElementById('storageBagList').innerHTML=storageRows(player.inventory,'store',storageUnits(activeStorageChest)>=HOME_CHEST_CAPACITY)}

function refreshPanelState(){document.body.classList.toggle('panel-open',!document.getElementById('premiumScreen').hidden||!document.getElementById('adventureScreen').hidden||!travelScreen.hidden||!inventoryScreen.hidden||!characterScreen.hidden||!skillsScreen.hidden||!shopScreen.hidden||!partyScreen.hidden||!storageScreen.hidden||!questScreen.hidden||!saveFilesScreen.hidden)}
function travelLock(id){if(maps[id].town)return '';if(id==='mosslight'&&!hasFourfoldKey)return 'Complete all four companion stories (two chapters each) to forge the Fourfold Keystone';if(id==='emberdeep'&&!hasSigil)return 'Find the Ember Rune';return ''}

// v1.81: readable parchment atlas; the compass grid and all travel gates are retained.
function atlasBiome(id){if(frontierBiomes[id])return frontierBiomes[id];return ['glassridge','frostwood','northridge','frostmarch','icecoast'].includes(id)?'snow':['redfen','willowfen','fenroad'].includes(id)?'marsh':['coastroad','sunharbor'].includes(id)?'coast':['cinderfields','emberdeep'].includes(id)?'ash':['crowfield','meadowroad','stonewatchroad'].includes(id)?'plains':'forest'}
function atlasIcon(id){const m=maps[id];return m.town?'town':id==='mosslight'?'shrine':id==='emberdeep'?'cave':m.landmark==='watchtower'?'tower':m.landmark==='bandit_camp'?'camp':atlasBiome(id)==='snow'?'mountain':atlasBiome(id)==='coast'?'anchor':atlasBiome(id)==='marsh'?'reeds':atlasBiome(id)==='ash'?'cave':atlasBiome(id)==='plains'?'wheat':'pine'}
function atlasLocationArt(id){const m=maps[id];return m.town?'hall':id==='mosslight'?'runestone':id==='emberdeep'?'ruin':m.landmark==='watchtower'?'tower':m.landmark==='bandit_camp'?'tent':atlasBiome(id)==='snow'?'rock':atlasBiome(id)==='ash'?'ruin':'pine'}
function drawThemedWorldMap(){
 const canvas=document.getElementById('themedWorldMap');if(!canvas)return;const size=worldGrid.length*180;canvas.width=canvas.height=size;const g=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!g)return;
 const colors={grass:'#394c28',snow:'#9baaa5',marsh:'#36412c',stone:'#5a5b50',dirt:'#81603c',dungeon:'#43413c',water:'#254f55'},patterns={};
 const surface=key=>{if(patterns[key])return patterns[key];if(!artReady('terrain'))return colors[key];
  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=tile.height=128;const t=tile.getContext('2d');t.drawImage(detailedArt.terrain,...detailedFrames.terrain[key],0,0,128,128);patterns[key]=g.createPattern(tile,'repeat');return patterns[key];};
 const sprite=(key,x,y,h,target=g)=>{if(!artReady('environment'))return;const f=detailedFrames.environment[key],w=h*f[2]/f[3];target.drawImage(detailedArt.environment,...f,x-w/2,y-h,w,h);};
 g.clearRect(0,0,size,size);g.fillStyle=surface('grass');g.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
 // Soft biome boundaries keep the world continuous instead of dividing it into tiles.
 worldGrid.forEach((row,y)=>row.forEach((id,x)=>{const biome=atlasBiome(id),key={snow:'snow',marsh:'marsh',coast:'grass',ash:'dungeon',plains:'grass',forest:'grass'}[biome];if(key==='grass')return;
  const patch=document.createElement('canvas');patch.width=patch.height=300;const p=patch.getContext('2d');p.translate(-x*180+60,-y*180+60);p.fillStyle=surface(key);p.fillRect(x*180-60,y*180-60,300,300);p.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);p.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';const fade=p.createRadialGradient(150,150,75,150,150,150);fade.addColorStop(0,'#fff');fade.addColorStop(1,'#fff0');p.fillStyle=fade;p.fillRect(0,0,300,300);g.drawImage(patch,x*180-60,y*180-60);
 }));
 g.save();g.scale(size/900,size/900);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(845,0);g.bezierCurveTo(780,150,875,260,838,390);g.bezierCurveTo(810,520,860,680,900,900);g.lineTo(900,0);g.closePath();g.fillStyle=surface('water');g.fill();g.lineWidth=4;g.strokeStyle='#6c81735c';g.stroke();g.restore();
 g.save();g.scale(size/900,size/900);const river=()=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(360,0);g.bezierCurveTo(335,170,405,260,365,450);g.bezierCurveTo(325,610,405,745,355,900);};river();g.lineWidth=21;g.strokeStyle='#23382b';g.stroke();river();g.lineWidth=13;g.strokeStyle=surface('water');g.stroke();g.restore();
 // Dirt roads connect exactly the same neighboring regions as the playable world.
 g.beginPath();worldGrid.forEach((row,y)=>row.forEach((id,x)=>{const cx=x*180+90,cy=y*180+90;if(x<row.length-1){g.moveTo(cx,cy);g.lineTo(cx+180,cy);}if(y<worldGrid.length-1){g.moveTo(cx,cy);g.lineTo(cx,cy+180);}}));g.lineWidth=18;g.strokeStyle='#27331e99';g.stroke();g.lineWidth=12;g.strokeStyle=surface('dirt');g.stroke();
 // Timber bridges carry the east-west roads across the river.
 for(let y=90;y<size;y+=180){g.fillStyle='#816948';g.fillRect(size*.4-48,y-10,96,20);g.strokeStyle='#403426';g.lineWidth=2;for(let x=size*.4-45;x<size*.4+48;x+=7){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y-10);g.lineTo(x,y+10);g.stroke();}}
 worldGrid.forEach((row,y)=>row.forEach((id,x)=>{const biome=atlasBiome(id);for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const px=x*180+18+(i*47+x*17)%145,py=y*180+24+(i*67+y*23)%135;if(Math.abs(px-(x*180+90))<48&&Math.abs(py-(y*180+90))<45)continue;if(px>size-80)continue;const key=biome==='snow'?(i%3?'pine':'rock'):biome==='ash'?(i%3?'rock':'ruin'):biome==='marsh'?(i%2?'bush':'oak'):i%4?'pine':'oak';sprite(key,px,py,biome==='ash'?25:34+(i%3)*9);}}));
 const shade=g.createRadialGradient(size/2,size/2,size*.18,size/2,size/2,size*.69);shade.addColorStop(0,'#07120a00');shade.addColorStop(1,'#07120a99');g.fillStyle=shade;g.fillRect(0,0,size,size);g.strokeStyle='#8b90664d';g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeRect(8,8,size-16,size-16);
 document.querySelectorAll('.mapLocationArt').forEach(icon=>{const c=icon.getContext('2d');if(!c)return;c.clearRect(0,0,70,62);sprite(atlasLocationArt(icon.dataset.mapIcon),35,60,56,c);});
 // Assets also load asynchronously when opening a freshly downloaded game.
 for(const group of ['terrain','environment'])if(!artReady(group)&&detailedArt[group]&&!detailedArt[group]._worldMapWait){detailedArt[group]._worldMapWait=true;detailedArt[group].addEventListener('load',()=>{detailedArt[group]._worldMapWait=false;drawThemedWorldMap();},{once:true});}
}

 el.innerHTML='<div class="atlasLegend"><span>◆ Your location</span><span>✦ Tracked quest</span><span>◇ Unexplored</span></div><div class="atlasScroller" id="atlasScroller" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scrollable world map"><div class="worldMapView atlasView"><canvas id="themedWorldMap" class="atlasArt" width="1620" height="1620" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><span class="mapLabel north">NORTH · FROSTLANDS</span><span class="mapLabel south">SOUTH · ASHEN FRONTIER</span><span class="mapLabel west">WEST · OLD FORESTS</span><span class="mapLabel east">EAST · TIDELANDS</span>'+Object.keys(worldPositions).map(node).join('')+'</div></div><div class="atlasHint" id="atlasSelection">Follow the dirt roads through the Reach. }

function paintArt(key,x,y,w,h,group='environment',opacity=1){

function regionSurface(){
 if(activeMap.interior)return 'wood';if(activeMap.dungeon||storyDungeons[mapId]||['mosslight','emberdeep'].includes(mapId))return 'dungeon';
 if(frontierBiomes[mapId]==='snow'||/frost|glassridge/.test(mapId))return 'snow';if(frontierBiomes[mapId]==='marsh'||/fen/.test(mapId))return 'marsh';if(frontierBiomes[mapId]==='ash')return 'dungeon';if(/highmoor|stonewatchroad/.test(mapId))return 'stone';return 'grass';
}
function paintSurface(key,x,y,w,h,size=112){
 if(!artReady('terrain'))return false;const f=detailedFrames.terrain[key];if(!f)return false;
 const cacheKey=key+':'+size;let p=surfacePatterns[cacheKey];
 if(!p){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'),n=4,stride=Math.round(size*.7);c.width=c.height=stride*n;const g=c.getContext('2d');g.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
  const colors={grass:'#4b6234',marsh:'#414a2f',stone:'#737065',snow:'#c8d5d0',dirt:'#90663c',dungeon:'#49484c',wood:'#765436',water:'#285e69'};
  g.fillStyle=colors[key]||'#46513b';g.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=tile.height=size;const t=tile.getContext('2d');
  t.drawImage(detailedArt.terrain,...f,0,0,size,size);
  // Feather all four edges so generated atlas borders do not form a grid.
  t.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';let fade=t.createLinearGradient(0,0,size,0);
  fade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');fade.addColorStop(.16,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');fade.addColorStop(.84,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');fade.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');t.fillStyle=fade;t.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
  fade=t.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,size);fade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');fade.addColorStop(.16,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');fade.addColorStop(.84,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');fade.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');t.fillStyle=fade;t.fillRect(0,0,size,size);
  for(let row=-1;row<=n;row++)for(let col=-1;col<=n;col++){
   const seed=((row+n)%n*37+(col+n)%n*19)%8,px=col*stride+(row%2?stride/2:0),py=row*stride;
   g.save();g.translate(px+size/2,py+size/2);g.scale(seed%2?-1:1,seed%3?-1:1);g.globalAlpha=key==='marsh'?.72:.9;g.drawImage(tile,-size/2,-size/2);g.restore();
  }
  p=ctx.createPattern(c,'repeat');surfacePatterns[cacheKey]=p;
 }
 ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=p;ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);ctx.restore();return true;
}

function drawDetailedWorldObject(obj){
 let key=null,height=48,dim=false;
 if(obj.id.startsWith('story_portal_')){drawCaveEntrance(obj.x,obj.y,storyDungeons[obj.dungeon].style,!!storyPortalLock(obj.dungeon));return true}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('secret_')){if(Math.hypot(player.x-obj.x,player.y-obj.y)>115)return true;key='chest';height=35;dim=!!townQuestState[obj.id]?.claimed}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('story_cache_')||obj.id==='tower_cache'){key='chest';height=40;dim=!!townQuestState['story_'+obj.dungeon]?.claimed}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('story_ward_')){key='runestone';height=52;dim=townQuestState['story_'+obj.dungeon]?.wards?.includes(obj.index)}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('armory_')||obj.id==='campaign_chronicle'||obj.id==='tower_tablet'||obj.id==='rescue_notice'){return standArt(obj.id==='tower_tablet'?'tablet':'notice',obj.x,obj.y,48,'extras')}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('gear_waystone_')){key='runestone';height=55}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('beacon_')){key='campfire';height=36}
 else if(obj.id.startsWith('epilogue_')||obj.id==='crossroads_medicine')return standArt('traveler',obj.x,obj.y,50,'actors');
 if(key==='chest'&&dim)return standArt('openchest',obj.x,obj.y,height,'extras');return key?standArt(key,obj.x,obj.y,height,'environment',dim?.5:1):false;
}

 outline();ctx.strokeStyle='#5f7961';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.stroke();outline();ctx.strokeStyle='#a6b49288';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}

function decorateItemIcons(root=document){
 if(!artReady('items'))return;
 for(const el of root.querySelectorAll('.itemIcon,.itemTileIcon,.gearSlotIcon,.slotIcon,#itemDetailIcon')){
  const text=el.textContent.trim();if(!text||['💎','📿','👖','🥾'].includes(text))continue;let key=itemSpriteKeys[text];
  const context=el.parentElement?.textContent||'';
  if(/ore|alloy|iron|copper|silver/i.test(context))key=/copper/i.test(context)?'copper':'silver';
  if(/armor|chainmail|plate|cuirass/i.test(context)&&!(/staff|blade/i.test(context)))key='armor';
  if(/shield/i.test(context)&&/cleric|sacred|ivory|order/i.test(context))key='sacredshield';
  if(/potion|tonic|ration/i.test(context))key=/ration/i.test(context)?'food':'potion';
  if(/scroll|parchment|map/i.test(context))key='scroll';if(/coin|crown|gold pouch/i.test(context))key='coins';if(!key)key='rune';const group=detailedFrames.extras[key]?'extras':'items',f=detailedFrames[group][key],a=detailedArt[group];
  el.textContent='';el.classList.add('paintedItemIcon');el.classList.toggle('paintedExtraIcon',group==='extras');
  el.style.backgroundImage='url('+a.src+')'; // Keep equipped icons visible despite slot background styling.
  el.style.backgroundSize=(a.naturalWidth/f[2]*100)+'% '+(a.naturalHeight/f[3]*100)+'%';
  el.style.backgroundPosition=(f[0]/(a.naturalWidth-f[2])*100)+'% '+(f[1]/(a.naturalHeight-f[3])*100)+'%';
 }
}
const itemArtStyle=document.createElement('style');itemArtStyle.textContent='.paintedItemIcon{background-image:url('+detailedArt.items.src+');background-repeat:no-repeat;display:inline-block;width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 42px;vertical-align:middle}.itemTileIcon.paintedItemIcon{width:46px;height:46px}#itemDetailIcon.paintedItemIcon{width:70px;height:70px}.slotIcon.paintedItemIcon{width:30px;height:30px;flex-basis:30px}.paintedExtraIcon{background-image:url('+detailedArt.extras.src+')}';document.head.appendChild(itemArtStyle);detailedArt.items.onload=()=>decorateItemIcons();
const iconObserver=new MutationObserver(()=>decorateItemIcons());
iconObserver.observe(document.querySelector('.shell'),{childList:true,subtree:true});

function labelCoversActor(left,top,right,bottom){
 const actors=[player,...activeCompanions().filter(c=>c.hp>0),...(activeMap.town?activeMap.npcs:[])];
 return actors.some(a=>rectsOverlap([left,top,right,bottom],[a.x-24,a.y-58,a.x+24,a.y+12]));
}
function drawLocationLabel(x,y,label){ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';const w=ctx.measureText(label).width+16;if(labelCoversActor(x-w/2,y-12,x+w/2,y+12)){ctx.restore();return}ctx.fillStyle='#142019f2';ctx.fillRect(x-w/2,y-12,w,24);ctx.strokeStyle='#bda572';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeRect(x-w/2,y-12,w,24);ctx.fillStyle='#fff0b2';ctx.fillText(label,x,y);ctx.restore();}
function drawTownHouseLabels(){
 if(!activeMap.town)return;
 const used=new Set(activeMap.npcs.map(n=>n.frontage));used.add('classHome');
 ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
 for(const key of used){
  const front=townFrontages[key];if(!front)continue;
  const lines=key==='slayers'?['SLAYERS','HALL']:key==='classHome'?['CLASS HOUSE',ownsHome(activeMap.homeId)?'OWNED':'FOR SALE']:key==='companion'?['COMPANION','HOUSE']:[front.label];
  const width=Math.ceil(Math.max(...lines.map(line=>ctx.measureText(line).width)))+16,height=lines.length*16+8;
  const top=usesOpenWorld()?cameraY-OPEN_WORLD_ORIGIN_Y:0;
  if(front.y+front.h<top||front.y>top+(viewH/roomScale)-22)continue;
  const x=front.x+front.w/2,y=front.y+4-height;const left=usesOpenWorld()?cameraX-OPEN_WORLD_ORIGIN_X:cameraX,right=left+viewW/roomScale,bottom=top+viewH/roomScale-24;if(x-width/2<left+4||x+width/2>right-4||y<top+48||y+height>bottom)continue;
  if(labelCoversActor(x-width/2,y,x+width/2,y+height))continue;
  ctx.fillStyle='#172019';ctx.fillRect(x-width/2,y,width,height);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#d6bd86';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(x-width/2,y,width,height);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff0b2';lines.forEach((line,i)=>ctx.fillText(line,x,y+12+i*16));
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function drawCompanionLabels(){
 ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';const placed=[];
 for(const c of activeCompanions()){
  if(c.hp<=0||Math.hypot(player.x-c.x,player.y-c.y)>=160)continue;
  const name=c.name.split(' the ')[0],w=ctx.measureText(name).width+12;let y=c.y-66;
  while(placed.some(r=>Math.abs(c.x-r.x)<(w+r.w)/2+5&&Math.abs(y-r.y)<21))y-=22;
  placed.push({x:c.x,y,w});ctx.strokeStyle='#d6c59066';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(c.x,y+10);ctx.lineTo(c.x,c.y-55);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#132019e8';ctx.fillRect(c.x-w/2,y-9,w,18);ctx.fillStyle='#fff0b2';ctx.fillText(name,c.x,y);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function draw(){
 // Outdoor locations use a larger top-down world with a player-following camera.
 const outdoor=usesOpenWorld(),ox=outdoor?OPEN_WORLD_ORIGIN_X:0,oy=outdoor?OPEN_WORLD_ORIGIN_Y:0,worldW=outdoor?OPEN_WORLD_WIDTH:W,worldH=outdoor?OPEN_WORLD_HEIGHT:H;
 ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.fillStyle='#18211d';ctx.fillRect(0,0,viewW,viewH);ctx.save();ctx.scale(roomScale,roomScale);ctx.translate(ox-cameraX+(impactShake>0?Math.sin(animationClock*95)*2:0),oy-cameraY);
 // Pixel-tiled meadow and scene floor

function interactQuest(n){const q=townQuestDefs[n.questId];if(!q)return talk(n);let state=townQuestState[n.questId];if(!state){if(q.requires&&!townQuestState[q.requires]?.claimed){say('Finish '+townQuestDefs[q.requires].title+' first to continue '+q.arc.split(' · ')[1]+'.');return true}townQuestState[n.questId]={accepted:true,kills:0,claimed:false};say(q.arc+' — '+q.intro+' Objective: '+q.desc);saveGame();return true}if(state.claimed){say(q.title+' is complete. // Route taps through the same collision geometry used by movement.
const walkGridCache=new Map();
function walkingLine(id,a,b,r){const d=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),n=Math.ceil(d/8);for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)if(mapPlacementBlocked(id,a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n,r))return false;return true}
function walkingGrid(id,r){const key=id+':'+r;if(walkGridCache.has(key))return walkGridCache.get(key);const b=worldBounds(id),step=24,cols=Math.floor((b.maxX-b.minX)/step)+1,rows=Math.floor((b.maxY-b.minY)/step)+1,free=new Uint8Array(cols*rows),point=i=>({x:b.minX+i%cols*step,y:b.minY+Math.floor(i/cols)*step});for(let i=0;i<free.length;i++){const p=point(i);free[i]=!mapPlacementBlocked(id,p.x,p.y,r)}const grid={b,step,cols,rows,free,point};walkGridCache.set(key,grid);return grid}
function findWalkingPath(id,start,target,r=14){
 if(walkingLine(id,start,target,r))return [target];
 const g=walkingGrid(id,r),{cols,rows,free,point,step,b}=g;
 const nearest=p=>{let best=-1,dist=Infinity;const cx=Math.round((p.x-b.minX)/step),cy=Math.round((p.y-b.minY)/step);for(let dy=-4;dy<=4;dy++)for(let dx=-4;dx<=4;dx++){const x=cx+dx,y=cy+dy;if(x<0||y<0||x>=cols||y>=rows)continue;const i=y*cols+x,q=point(i),d=Math.hypot(p.x-q.x,p.y-q.y);if(free[i]&&d<dist&&walkingLine(id,p,q,r)){best=i;dist=d}}return best};
 const source=nearest(start),goal=nearest(target);if(source<0||goal<0)return null;
 const prev=new Int32Array(free.length);prev.fill(-1);prev[source]=source;const queue=[source];
 for(let head=0;head<queue.length&&prev[goal]<0;head++){const i=queue[head],x=i%cols,y=Math.floor(i/cols);for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=cols||ny>=rows)continue;const j=ny*cols+nx;if(!free[j]||prev[j]>=0||!walkingLine(id,point(i),point(j),r))continue;prev[j]=i;queue.push(j)}}
 if(prev[goal]<0)return null;const path=[target];for(let i=goal;i!==source;i=prev[i])path.push(point(i));path.push(point(source));path.reverse();return path;
}
function nextWalkingTarget(){if(!tapTarget)return null;if(tapTarget.routeMap!==mapId||!tapTarget.path){const destination=safeMapPosition(mapId,tapTarget.x,tapTarget.y,player.r);const path=findWalkingPath(mapId,player,destination,player.r);if(!path){tapTarget=null;say('No clear walking route. Try a nearby road.');return null}tapTarget={...destination,routeMap:mapId,path}}while(tapTarget.path.length&&Math.hypot(tapTarget.path[0].x-player.x,tapTarget.path[0].y-player.y)<4)tapTarget.path.shift();if(!tapTarget.path.length){tapTarget=null;return null}return tapTarget.path[0]}
function overlaps(x,y,r){return mapPlacementBlocked(mapId,x,y,r);}
function legacySceneryOverlap(x,y,r){if(storyDungeons[mapId]&&(x<68+r||x>892-r||y<76+r||(y>524-r&&Math.abs(x-480)>40-r)))return true;for(const [tx,ty] of trees)if(Math.hypot(x-tx,y-ty)<r+17)return true;for(const [sx,sy] of stones)if(Math.hypot(x-sx,y-sy)<r+10)return true;return false}

 if(style==='fire')dungeonHazards.push({kind:'ring',x:e.x,y:e.y,inner:55,radius:135,delay:1,life:1.35,source:e});
 if(style==='tide'){if(storyWards(e.storyBoss)<2){const heal=Math.min(e.maxHp-e.hp,Math.ceil(e.maxHp*.08));e.hp+=heal;if(heal)combatText(e.x,e.y-35,'+'+heal,'#8dddf0')}for(const ally of [player,...activeCompanions()].slice(0,3))dungeonHazards.push({kind:'pool',x:ally.x,y:ally.y,radius:48,delay:1.1,life:1.45,source:e})}
 if(style==='storm')for(const x of [200,480,760])dungeonHazards.push({kind:'lane',x,width:70,delay:1,life:1.35,source:e});
}
function tickDungeonHazards(dt){for(const h of dungeonHazards){h.delay-=dt;h.life-=dt;if(h.delay<=0&&!h.hit){h.hit=true;if(!h.source.alive)continue;for(const ally of [player,...activeCompanions()]){const d=Math.hypot(ally.x-h.x,ally.y-(h.y||0)),inside=h.kind==='lane'?Math.abs(ally.x-h.x)<h.width/2:h.kind==='ring'?d<h.radius&&d>h.inner:d<h.radius;if(ally.hp>0&&inside)enemyHit(ally,h.source)}}}dungeonHazards=dungeonHazards.filter(h=>h.life>0&&h.source.alive)}

function clearCombatLine(x,y,tx,ty){const d=Math.hypot(tx-x,ty-y),steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(d/14));for(let i=1;i<steps;i++)if(overlaps(x+(tx-x)*i/steps,y+(ty-y)*i/steps,4))return false;return true}
function steerActor(actor,tx,ty,speed,dt,r=12){const d=Math.hypot(tx-actor.x,ty-actor.y);if(d<3)return false;const angle=Math.atan2(ty-actor.y,tx-actor.x),step=Math.min(d,speed*dt);for(const turn of [0,.55,-.55,1.05,-1.05,1.57,-1.57]){const dx=Math.cos(angle+turn)*step,dy=Math.sin(angle+turn)*step;if(!overlaps(actor.x+dx,actor.y+dy,r)){actor.x+=dx;actor.y+=dy;actor.faceX=Math.cos(angle+turn);actor.faceY=Math.sin(angle+turn);return true}}return false}

function dodge(){if(!combatReady()||dodgeCooldown>0)return;let [dx,dy]=movementAxes();if(!dx&&!dy){dx=player.faceX;dy=player.faceY}const n=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,b=worldBounds();tapTarget=null;for(let i=0;i<15;i++){const x=clamp(player.x+dx/n*6,b.minX,b.maxX),y=clamp(player.y+dy/n*6,b.minY,b.maxY);if(overlaps(x,y,player.r))break;player.x=x;player.y=y}player.dodgeTime=.4;dodgeCooldown=2.5;dodgeGuard=.4;combatText(player.x,player.y-28,'DODGE','#a4dfff');updateCamera();refreshCombatControls()}
