function updateEnemyCombat(e,dt){
 if(e.storyBoss)storyBossSpecial(e,dt);e.combatCool=Math.max(0,(e.combatCool||0)-dt);const pattern=enemyPattern(e);
 if(e.stun>0){e.stun=Math.max(0,e.stun-dt);e.windup=0;e.swing=null;return}
 if(e.windup>0&&e.swing){e.windup-=dt;if(e.windup<=0){const swing=e.swing;e.swing=null;combatEffects.push({x:swing.x,y:swing.y,radius:swing.radius,color:'#ff7061',life:.25});if(pattern.ranged)battleVfx('Earth_Spike',swing.x,swing.y-15,80);for(const victim of [player,...activeCompanions()])if(victim.hp>0&&Math.hypot(victim.x-swing.x,victim.y-swing.y)<swing.radius+10){enemyHit(victim,e);if(victim===player&&dodgeGuard<=0&&e.kind==='spider'){slowTimer=1.5;combatText(player.x,player.y-40,'SLOWED','#b5d590')}}e.combatCool=pattern.cool;}return}
 let target=player,d=Math.hypot(player.x-e.x,player.y-e.y);for(const ally of activeCompanions()){if(ally.hp<=0)continue;const ad=Math.hypot(ally.x-e.x,ally.y-e.y);if(ad<d){d=ad;target=ally}}
 const homeDistance=Math.hypot(e.x-e.spawnX,e.y-e.spawnY);if(!e.boss&&!e.eventRegion&&!e.storyBoss&&(homeDistance>330||d>270)){e.returning=true;steerActor(e,e.spawnX,e.spawnY,pattern.speed*1.3,dt);if(homeDistance<12){e.returning=false;e.hp=Math.min(e.maxHp,e.hp+dt*3)}return}e.returning=false;
 if(d<pattern.range&&e.combatCool<=0&&clearCombatLine(e.x,e.y,target.x,target.y)){e.windup=pattern.windup;e.windupLength=e.windup;e.swing={x:target.x,y:target.y,radius:pattern.radius};return}
 if(d<250&&d>28){if(pattern.ranged&&d<80){steerActor(e,e.x+(e.x-target.x),e.y+(e.y-target.y),pattern.speed*.7,dt)}else steerActor(e,target.x,target.y,pattern.speed,dt)}
}

const movementDirections={ArrowUp:[0,-1],ArrowDown:[0,1],ArrowLeft:[-1,0],ArrowRight:[1,0],DiagonalNW:[-1,-1],DiagonalNE:[1,-1],DiagonalSW:[-1,1],DiagonalSE:[1,1]};
function movementAxes(){let dx=0,dy=0;for(const key of keys){const d=movementDirections[key.startsWith('Touch:')?key.slice(6):key];if(d){dx+=d[0];dy+=d[1]}}return [Math.sign(dx),Math.sign(dy)]}
const tapStep=key=>{const direction=movementDirections[key];if(!direction)return;const bounds=worldBounds(),length=Math.hypot(...direction);tapTarget={x:clamp(player.x+direction[0]/length*48,bounds.minX,bounds.maxX),y:clamp(player.y+direction[1]/length*48,bounds.minY,bounds.maxY)}};
const movementPad=document.querySelector('.controls'),movementTouches=new Map();
const padSectors=['ArrowRight','DiagonalSE','ArrowDown','DiagonalSW','ArrowLeft','DiagonalNW','ArrowUp','DiagonalNE'];
function refreshHeldDirections(){
 for(const key of [...keys])if(key.startsWith('Touch:'))keys.delete(key);
 for(const touch of movementTouches.values())if(touch.key)keys.add('Touch:'+touch.key);
 for(const button of movementPad.querySelectorAll('[data-key]'))button.classList.toggle('directionHeld',[...movementTouches.values()].some(t=>t.key===button.dataset.key));
}
function startPadTouch(id,key,x,y){movementTouches.set(id,{key,x,y,started:performance.now(),dragged:false,sector:padSectors.indexOf(key)});tapTarget=null;refreshHeldDirections()}
function slidePadTouch(id,x,y){
 const touch=movementTouches.get(id);if(!touch)return;
 if(Math.hypot(x-touch.x,y-touch.y)<4&&!touch.dragged)return;
 touch.dragged=true;tapTarget=null;
 const rect=movementPad.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=x-(rect.left+rect.width/2),dy=y-(rect.top+rect.height/2);
 if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<Math.min(rect.width,rect.height)*.10){touch.key=null;touch.sector=-1;refreshHeldDirections();return}
 const angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx),sector=(Math.round(angle/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8;
 // Keep a small margin around sector boundaries so finger jitter does not switch directions.
 if(touch.sector>=0&&sector!==touch.sector){const previous=touch.sector*Math.PI/4,delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-previous),Math.cos(angle-previous));if(Math.abs(delta)<Math.PI/8+.08)return}
 touch.sector=sector;touch.key=padSectors[sector];refreshHeldDirections();
}
function endPadTouch(id,tap=false){const touch=movementTouches.get(id);if(!touch)return;movementTouches.delete(id);refreshHeldDirections();if(tap&&!touch.dragged&&touch.key&&performance.now()-touch.started<180&&movementTouches.size===0)tapStep(touch.key)}
function clearPadTouches(){movementTouches.clear();refreshHeldDirections()}

 event.preventDefault();startPadTouch(event.pointerId,button.dataset.key,event.clientX,event.clientY);
 try{movementPad.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)}catch{}
});
movementPad.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>{if(movementTouches.has(event.pointerId)){event.preventDefault();slidePadTouch(event.pointerId,event.clientX,event.clientY)}});
movementPad.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>endPadTouch(event.pointerId,true));
for(const type of ['pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])movementPad.addEventListener(type,event=>endPadTouch(event.pointerId));
window.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>endPadTouch(event.pointerId));window.addEventListener('pointercancel',event=>endPadTouch(event.pointerId));

function questGuide(q){
 let destination=null,detail=q.desc,progress=q.active?'In progress':'Find the quest giver',ready=false;
 const st=townQuestState[q.id]||{},townId=name=>Object.keys(maps).find(id=>maps[id].town&&maps[id].name.toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase()));

  else if(q.id.startsWith('slayer_')){const huntId=q.id.slice(7),d=slayerContracts[huntId],h=slayerHunt(huntId);if(d&&h?.accepted){ready=h.kills>=h.target;destination=ready?(activeMap.town?mapId:classOrigins[player.class].town):d.area;detail=ready?'Return to Warden Rook at any town’s Slayers Hall to claim '+slayerRewardText(h)+'.':'Defeat '+(h.target-h.kills)+' more '+d.monster+' in '+maps[d.area].name+'. '+d.hint;progress=Math.min(h.kills,h.target)+'/'+h.target+' defeated';}}
  else if(q.id==='wayfarer_compass'){const state=townQuestState.wayfarer_compass||{},seals=state.seals||[],next=wayfarerTrials.find((t,i)=>!seals.includes(i));destination=!state.accepted?'ashvale':next?next.area:'northridge';detail=!state.accepted?'Read THE LOST COMPASS inscription in Ashvale to begin.':next?'Awaken the '+next.name+' trial in '+maps[next.area].name+', defeat all three guardians, then solve its runes.  return {destination:maps[destination]?destination:null,detail,progress,ready};

function questEscape(value){return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function renderQuests(){
 const id=trackedQuestId(),rows=questCatalog().filter(q=>!q.done).sort((a,b)=>(b.id===id)-(a.id===id)||Number(b.active)-Number(a.active));
 const markup=rows.map(q=>{const g=questGuide(q),selected=q.id===id;return '<article class="questEntry '+(selected?'tracked ':q.active?'active ':'')+'"><span class="questState">'+(selected?'Tracking':g.ready?'Ready':q.active?'Active':'Available lead')+'</span><h3>'+questEscape(q.title)+'</h3><p>'+questEscape(q.desc)+'</p><p class="questLiveProgress">'+questEscape(g.progress)+'</p><p class="questReward">'+questEscape(q.reward)+'</p><div class="questTrackActions"><button type="button" data-track-quest="'+q.id+'" aria-pressed="'+selected+'">'+(selected?'Stop tracking':'Track quest')+'</button>'+(g.destination?'<button type="button" data-quest-map="'+q.id+'">Show on map</button>':'')+'</div></article>'}).join('')||'<p class="questEmpty">No unfinished quests. All current quests are complete.</p>';

}

}
